incident.operatorText: Storm knocked out power in Cedar Heights and Westbank, heavy rain is coming, and Riverbend General Hospital is on backup generators. What should we do?
constraints: Riverbend General Hospital operating on backup generators.

finding.finding: An estimated 5280-6600 people in Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) require shelter due to power outages and anticipated heavy rain, significantly exceeding available capacity.
finding.detail: The combined population of Cedar Heights (Z-01) is 34200 and Westbank (Z-05) is 31800, totaling 66000 people. Assuming 8-10% require shelter, the demand ranges from 5280 to 6600. Current available beds across all active shelters total 2020.

evidence.summary: Population data for Z-01 and Z-05.
Available beds in all shelters.

assumptions: Approximately 8-10% of the affected population will require shelter.

finding.finding: Shelter allocation is proposed for 1840 individuals across five accessible, grid-powered shelters, prioritizing Westbank (Z-05) due to higher medical device dependency.
finding.detail: Westbank (Z-05) has a 4.1% medical device dependency (medDevicePct) and Cedar Heights (Z-01) has 2.1%. To prioritize vulnerable populations, an estimated 1005 beds are allocated to Z-05 across SHL-FGP (745 beds) and SHL-WCC (260 beds). The remaining 835 beds are allocated to Z-01 across SHL-LHS (390 beds), SHL-DRC (320 beds), and SHL-CLB (125 beds). All proposed shelters are grid-powered and accepting new arrivals.

evidence.summary: Vulnerability data for Z-01 and Z-05.
Capacity, power status, and accessibility of shelters.

recommendedAction.title: Approve Shelter Allocation Plan
recommendedAction.description: Approve the proposed shelter allocation for populations from Z-01 and Z-05 to SHL-FGP, SHL-WCC, SHL-LHS, SHL-DRC, and SHL-CLB.

finding.finding: Three available bus groups (BUS-1, BUS-2, BUS-3) can be staged immediately at Westbank (Z-05) to begin evacuating vulnerable populations.
finding.detail: Westbank (Z-05) has the highest medical device dependency (4.1%) among the affected zones, making its population highly vulnerable to the ongoing power outage and impending heavy rain. Staging three bus groups, each with a capacity of 40 passengers, will allow for immediate transport of 120 individuals to designated shelters.

evidence.summary: Vulnerability data for Z-05.
Availability and capacity of bus groups.

recommendedAction.title: Recommend Bus Staging for Evacuation
recommendedAction.description: Stage BUS-1, BUS-2, and BUS-3 at Z-05 for immediate evacuation of residents to shelters. This should be completed before '2026-07-02T17:20:00'.

assumptions: Bus groups are to be used for evacuating residents to shelters.

finding.finding: SHL-NGC (Northgate Church) with 180 available beds is not accessible and thus not included in the general allocation plan for the affected zones.
finding.detail: The Northgate Church shelter (SHL-NGC) has 180 available beds and grid power. However, its 'accessible' status is false, making it unsuitable for general allocation, especially given the high medical device dependency in Westbank (Z-05). It remains available for specific, non-mobility impaired cases or as a last resort.

evidence.summary: Accessibility status of SHL-NGC.
Vulnerability data, including medDevicePct, for affected zones.

finding.finding: Riverbend General Hospital is operating on backup power.
finding.detail: Riverbend General Hospital (HOSP-RG) in zone Z-05 has 8 hours of generator backup remaining as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00, with an estimated depletion time of 2026-07-03T01:20:00. This is a critical life-safety concern.

evidence.summary: Identified Riverbend General Hospital (HOSP-RG) on backup power with 8 hours remaining.

recommendedAction.title: Prioritize power restoration to Riverbend General Hospital
recommendedAction.description: Expedite power restoration efforts for CIRCUIT-Z-05 to ensure continuous power supply to Riverbend General Hospital (HOSP-RG) before its backup generators deplete at 2026-07-03T01:20:00.

finding.finding: Power restoration priority for outage OUT-1 is established.
finding.detail: The highest priority for restoration for outage OUT-1 is CIRCUIT-Z-05 due to Riverbend General Hospital (HOSP-RG) and three dark signalized intersections (SIG-04, SIG-05, SIG-06), requiring an estimated 3.75 crew hours. The next priority is CIRCUIT-Z-01, impacting three dark signalized intersections (SIG-01, SIG-02, SIG-03), requiring an estimated 2.75 crew hours.

evidence.summary: Restoration priority for outage OUT-1 with ranked circuits and crew hour estimates.

recommendedAction.title: Initiate power restoration for OUT-1 according to priority
recommendedAction.description: Dispatch power restoration crews to address CIRCUIT-Z-05 (estimated 3.75 crew hours) first, followed by CIRCUIT-Z-01 (estimated 2.75 crew hours), to prioritize life-safety facilities and critical infrastructure impacted by outage OUT-1.

finding.finding: Three signalized intersections are dark in Z-01.
finding.detail: Signal Cedar Heights & 1st (SIG-01), Signal Cedar Heights & 3rd (SIG-02), and Signal Cedar Heights & 5th (SIG-03) in Z-01 are without power as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00, impacting traffic flow and safety.

evidence.summary: Identified three dark signals (SIG-01, SIG-02, SIG-03) in Z-01.

recommendedAction.title: Coordinate traffic management in Z-01
recommendedAction.description: Deploy traffic control personnel to intersections of Signal Cedar Heights & 1st (SIG-01), Signal Cedar Heights & 3rd (SIG-02), and Signal Cedar Heights & 5th (SIG-03) in Z-01 to manage traffic manually until power is restored.

finding.finding: Three signalized intersections are dark in Z-05.
finding.detail: Signal Westbank & 1st (SIG-04), Signal Westbank & 3rd (SIG-05), and Signal Westbank & 5th (SIG-06) in Z-05 are without power as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00, impacting traffic flow and safety.

evidence.summary: Identified three dark signals (SIG-04, SIG-05, SIG-06) in Z-05.

recommendedAction.title: Coordinate traffic management in Z-05
recommendedAction.description: Deploy traffic control personnel to intersections of Signal Westbank & 1st (SIG-04), Signal Westbank & 3rd (SIG-05), and Signal Westbank & 5th (SIG-06) in Z-05 to manage traffic manually until power is restored.

finding.finding: Outage OUT-1 is affecting a significant number of customers.
finding.detail: The outage OUT-1, caused by a storm-damaged feeder F-114 at SUB-W1 (SCADA lockout), has resulted in 15125 customers losing power in zones Z-01 and Z-05 as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00.

evidence.summary: Reported 15125 customers out due to outage OUT-1.

finding.finding: Heavy rain will arrive in Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) at 2026-07-02T19:10:00.
finding.detail: Both Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) will experience heavy rain beginning at 2026-07-02T19:10:00, with a peak rainfall rate of 30 mm/hr and total accumulation of 60 mm expected. Westbank (Z-05) has a high flood relevance.

evidence.summary: Rain arrival and peak intensity for Z-01 and Z-05.

recommendedAction.title: Prepare for localized flooding
recommendedAction.description: Advise residents in low-lying areas of Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) to take precautions against localized flooding.

finding.finding: Wind gusts of 65 km/h will restrict utility crew operations in Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05).
finding.detail: Gusts reaching 65 km/h are expected in Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05). This wind speed restricts bucket-truck work and poses a hazard for high-profile vehicles and crews working aloft. A Wind Advisory is active until 2026-07-02T20:20:00.

evidence.summary: Wind gust speeds and crew impact for Z-01 and Z-05.
Wind Advisory details with gust speeds and expiry.

recommendedAction.title: Suspend high-risk outdoor work
recommendedAction.description: Utility Crews are advised to suspend all non-essential bucket-truck operations and other high-risk outdoor work in Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) until 2026-07-02T20:20:00.

finding.finding: Westbank (Z-05) is at high risk of flooding due to heavy rainfall and an activating floodplain.
finding.detail: Westbank (Z-05) has a high flood relevance with a peak rainfall rate of 30 mm/hr and 60 mm accumulated, leading to the activation of floodplain FP-WEST-N. This increases the risk of localized flooding in the area. A Flood Watch is in effect until 2026-07-02T23:10:00.

evidence.summary: High flood relevance and floodplain activation for Z-05.
Flood Watch alert with expiry.

recommendedAction.title: Activate flood response protocols
recommendedAction.description: Emergency Services should prepare to activate flood response protocols for Westbank (Z-05), focusing on areas around floodplain FP-WEST-N. Monitor water levels closely.

finding.finding: No direct evacuation routes were identified between Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) for flood assessment.
finding.detail: The system did not identify any direct routes between Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05). Consequently, no specific per-route flood-window findings can be generated for these zones based on currently identified routes.

evidence.summary: No routes found from Z-01 to Z-05.
No routes found from Z-05 to Z-01.

recommendedAction.title: Evaluate alternative evacuation strategies
recommendedAction.description: Emergency Services should investigate alternative evacuation strategies or prepare for localized shelter-in-place options for Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) due to the lack of identified direct evacuation routes.

finding.finding: Significant traffic congestion and dark signals are present in zones Z-01 (Cedar Heights) and Z-05 (Westbank).
finding.detail: Corridor COR-RIVER-W, serving Z-01 and Z-05, shows a congestion level of 0.77 (including dark-signal penalty) and is operating with dark signals. Corridor COR-MAIN-W in Z-05 has a high congestion level of 0.93 (including dark-signal penalty) and is also experiencing dark signals. These conditions, as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00, severely impede traffic flow and reduce road capacity.

evidence.summary: Congestion data showing levels and dark signals for corridors in Z-01 and Z-05 as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00.

finding.finding: No viable evacuation routes from affected zones Z-01 (Cedar Heights) and Z-05 (Westbank) could be identified.
finding.detail: Despite multiple attempts to find routes from Z-01 to Z-02, Z-03, and Z-06, and from Z-05 to Z-03 and Z-06, the `traffic_find_routes` tool returned no available routes as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00. This critical absence of routing information significantly hinders the ability to plan and execute an effective evacuation for the populations of 34200 in Z-01 and 31800 in Z-05.

evidence.summary: Tool call for routes from Z-01 to Z-03 returned no routes as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00.
Tool call for routes from Z-01 to Z-06 returned no routes as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00.

Population data for Z-01 (34200) and Z-05 (31800) as of 2026-07-02T17:20:00.

recommendedAction.title: Investigate route generation failure
recommendedAction.description: The CrisisGrid Operations team should immediately investigate why the `traffic_find_routes` tool is not returning any routes for evacuation from Z-01 and Z-05, even to adjacent connected zones, to identify potential system issues or unexpected scenario constraints. This is critical for planning any evacuation efforts.

turn.text: My previous shelter allocation plan for zones Z-01 and Z-05 is being amended. The designated shelters were incorrectly identified as being within these zones, as confirmed by shelter location data (tc-0d79438b-fa59-4406-8ea2-b3f4f974d714). No suitable grid-powered shelters accepting new arrivals are currently identified within Z-01 or Z-05, necessitating a revised plan.

amendedFinding.finding: Previous shelter allocation for zones Z-01 and Z-05 is invalid as the designated shelters are not located within these zones. No grid-powered shelters accepting new arrivals are currently identified within Z-01 or Z-05, necessitating a revised plan for the 1840 individuals from these areas, particularly prioritizing Z-05 due to high medical device dependency.
amendedFinding.detail: Upon review with the latest shelter data (tc-0d79438b-fa59-4406-8ea2-b3f4f974d714), it has been identified that the shelters previously allocated to Z-05 (SHL-FGP, SHL-WCC) are actually located in Z-07 and Z-09 respectively. sections.executiveSummary: Cedar Heights (Z-01) and Westbank (Z-05) are experiencing widespread power outages affecting 15125 customers, with Riverbend General Hospital (HOSP-RG) operating on backup power projected to deplete by 2026-07-03T01:20:00. Heavy rain is expected to begin at 2026-07-02T19:10:00, exacerbating a high flood risk in Westbank (Z-05) around floodplain FP-WEST-N. Furthermore, wind gusts of 65 km/h are restricting utility work until 2026-07-02T20:20:00. No viable evacuation routes have been identified for either zone, and available shelter capacity of 2020 beds is significantly less than the 5280-6600 people requiring shelter. The immediate plan prioritizes expediting power restoration to CIRCUIT-Z-05 to support Riverbend General Hospital (HOSP-RG), suspending high-risk outdoor utility work due to winds, and initiating an investigation into the failure to identify evacuation routes for Z-01 and Z-05.
sections.outlook: During the next operational period, efforts will focus on initiating priority power restoration for CIRCUIT-Z-01 and continuing to evaluate alternative evacuation and shelter-in-place strategies due to the confirmed lack of suitable shelters within the affected zones. A re-plan would be triggered if Riverbend General Hospital (HOSP-RG)'s backup power depletes before restoration, if viable evacuation routes cannot be established for Z-01 and Z-05, or if flood conditions in Westbank (Z-05) escalate beyond current projections, impacting critical infrastructure or safety.
